name: io.github.MyMemoAI/openmymemo
title: OpenMyMemo
description: Your AI memory as a local folder you own. Every app shares it; you see and can undo each change.

packageArguments.name: --connector
packageArguments.description: The name this app gets in the OpenMyMemo panel, where you set what it may read and write.
Create the memory folder on first use.

packageArguments.name: --panel-port
packageArguments.description: Also serve the review panel at http://127.0.0.1:<port> while this app runs.

environmentVariables.name: OPENMYMEMO_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Your memory folder. Leave it empty for ~/OpenMyMemo; use the same folder in every app to share one memory.
